description: Flat metadata schema for individual EEG/ERP trial records from human visual-stimulus experiments, including participant context, stimulus properties, timing, responses, and acquisition settings.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record or trial/epoch entry.

study_id.descr: Identifier for the parent study or experiment protocol.

subject_id.descr: Participant identifier; use a coded, non-identifying ID.

session_id.descr: Identifier for the recording session or visit.

recording_date.descr: Date of EEG recording in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

subject_age_years.descr: Participant age in years at the time of recording.

subject_sex.descr: Participant sex/gender category as recorded (e.g., female, male, intersex, nonbinary, unknown).

handedness.descr: Participant handedness category (e.g., left, right, ambidextrous, unknown).

vision_status.descr: Visual status relevant to the experiment (e.g., normal, corrected_to_normal, impaired).

inclusion_status.descr: Whether the record/participant met inclusion criteria for the analysis (true/false).

trial_number.descr: Sequential trial index within the session, starting from 1.

block_number.descr: Experimental block number within the session, starting from 1.

condition_label.descr: Experimental condition label for the trial (e.g., control, target, oddball, congruent, incongruent).

stimulus_modality.descr: Stimulus modality; for this dataset typically visual.

stimulus_class.descr: High-level stimulus category (e.g., face, object, word, scene, checkerboard, symbol).

stimulus_id.descr: Identifier for the specific stimulus image/item presented.

stimulus_description.descr: Short text description of the stimulus content or category.

stimulus_file_name.descr: Original filename or asset name of the stimulus used in the trial.

stimulus_intensity.descr: Stimulus intensity or luminance level if applicable, in device-specific or standardized units.

stimulus_size_deg.descr: Stimulus size in degrees of visual angle, if applicable.

stimulus_position_x_deg.descr: Horizontal stimulus position relative to fixation, in degrees of visual angle.

stimulus_position_y_deg.descr: Vertical stimulus position relative to fixation, in degrees of visual angle.

stimulus_orientation_deg.descr: Stimulus orientation in degrees, where relevant.

stimulus_color_space.descr: Color space used to define the stimulus (e.g., RGB, grayscale, CIE Lab).

stimulus_duration_ms.descr: Duration of stimulus presentation in milliseconds.

stimulus_onset_time_ms.descr: Time of stimulus onset relative to recording start or trial start, in milliseconds.

stimulus_offset_time_ms.descr: Time of stimulus offset relative to recording start or trial start, in milliseconds.

prestimulus_interval_ms.descr: Duration of the pre-stimulus baseline or fixation interval in milliseconds.

poststimulus_interval_ms.descr: Duration of the post-stimulus interval or inter-trial interval in milliseconds.

response_required.descr: Whether the participant was instructed to respond on this trial.

response_given.descr: Whether the participant provided a response on this trial.

response_type.descr: Response modality or type (e.g., button_press, eye_movement, verbal, none).

response_key.descr: Button/key label or response code entered by the participant.

response_correct.descr: Whether the participant response matched the expected correct response, if defined.

response_time_ms.descr: Reaction time from stimulus onset to response in milliseconds.

response_value.descr: Numeric response value or score associated with the trial, if applicable.

erp_epoch_start_ms.descr: Start time of the ERP epoch relative to stimulus onset, in milliseconds (e.g., -200).

erp_epoch_end_ms.descr: End time of the ERP epoch relative to stimulus onset, in milliseconds (e.g., 800).

eeg_reference.descr: EEG reference scheme used during acquisition or preprocessing (e.g., linked mastoids, average reference, Cz).

eeg_ground.descr: EEG ground electrode location or scheme.

eeg_cap_type.descr: EEG cap or electrode montage type/model.

eeg_impedance_max_kohm.descr: Maximum electrode impedance observed during setup, in kilo-ohms.

filter_highpass_hz.descr: High-pass filter cutoff frequency in Hertz, if applied.

filter_lowpass_hz.descr: Low-pass filter cutoff frequency in Hertz, if applied.

line_noise_filter_hz.descr: Line-noise notch filter frequency in Hertz (e.g., 50 or 60), if applied.

artifact_present.descr: Whether the trial/epoch contains a detectable artifact (e.g., blink, movement, muscle).

artifact_type.descr: Primary artifact type if present (e.g., blink, saccade, movement, EMG, bad_channel).

artifact_rejected.descr: Whether the trial/epoch was rejected from analysis due to artifacts.

baseline_correction_applied.descr: Whether baseline correction was applied to the epoch.

baseline_window_ms.descr: Baseline correction window in milliseconds, if applicable, encoded as a single textual range such as '-200:0' when stored externally; use this field as a numeric summary if a single representative value is needed.

erp_component_label.descr: ERP component of interest for the trial/epoch if annotated (e.g., P1, N1, N170, P300, N400).

peak_latency_ms.descr: Observed ERP peak latency in milliseconds for the annotated component.

peak_amplitude_uV.descr: Observed ERP peak amplitude in microvolts for the annotated component.

analysis_window_ms.descr: Time window used for ERP measurement in milliseconds, reported as a numeric summary or central window value if not stored separately.

task_accuracy_block_pct.descr: Accuracy within the current block, expressed as percent correct, if calculated at the trial level for context.

participant_state.descr: Participant state during recording (e.g., rested, fatigued, drowsy, medicated).

environment_lighting.descr: Ambient lighting condition during visual stimulus presentation (e.g., dim, room_light, darkened).

screen_refresh_rate_hz.descr: Display refresh rate in Hertz used for stimulus presentation.

screen_distance_cm.descr: Distance from participant to display screen in centimeters.

fixation_used.descr: Whether a fixation cross or fixation point was used during the trial.
